newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson keeps Siemens at "buy".
newsitem.headline: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson keeps Siemens at "buy".

text.p: The research wing of Dresdner Bank, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, said on Friday that it had upped its EPS outlook for Siemens to 5.20 marks for 1997/98 and was recommending the stock as a "buy".
"Siemens' restructuring programme will be clearly noticeable by 1998/99," Heinz Steffen, analyst at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson told Reuters on Friday.
The research unit has issued a research document which maintains a "buy" recommendation on Siemens. The EPS outlook for 1996/97 is 4.50 marks.
Shares in Siemens ended IBIS DAX trade on Friday at 86.08 marks, up 79 pfennigs, and were one of the heaviest-traded stocks over the day.
